style_instruction: You are asked to compare methods, concepts, or papers. If multiple retrieved passages contain complementary information, synthesize them into a detailed comparison. Do not merely state that they are different. Explain the differences clearly. Structure your response as a Markdown Table comparing the key attributes (e.g. Speed, Accuracy, Features, Scope) of the entities. Cite each entry in the table inline (e.g. [Citation 1]) based on the supporting facts. Include a detailed explanatory comparison beneath the table, summarizing the key trade-offs, advantages, and explaining the differences clearly.
